title: Numerical Schemes for Coupled Fracture and Dissipation
exact_target: Develop a sound coupled framework and practical convergent schemes for fracture or damage interacting with time-dependent dissipation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004443 (OWR-17476-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Towards Predictive Methods for Kinetics in Plasticity, Fracture, and Damage (2020), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2020/13, pp. 713--783. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 35.
Rossi--Thomas (2017) (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The desired solution class must be selected explicitly: the report emphasizes that energetic and vanishing-viscosity evolutions can have different jumps. Efficiency alone is not convergence to the intended physical and mathematical evolution.
